text: Two traps. Silver carp eats plant plankton; its cousin the bighead eats animal plankton. And carps kept in ponds mature perfectly well, but they will not spawn, because they need river cues like rising, flowing monsoon water. Since nineteen fifty six, fish farmers inject hormones to make them spawn; today the drug Ovaprim is used.
